maddeler.e:
اشتملوا (form VIII)
# اِشْتَمَلُوا (ištamalū) /iʃ.ta.ma.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
# اُشْتُمِلُوا (uštumilū) /uʃ.tu.mi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
# اِشْتَمِلُوا (ištamilū) /iʃ.ta.mi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
